title: Cone Extended Rayleigh Quotients for Directed Graph Learning: Minimax Spectral Certificates, Sensitivity, and Adaptive Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.27122v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Directed graph learning naturally leads to trainable nonsymmetric propagation operators with distinct right and left spectral structures. Building on the two-sided cone Rayleigh framework for generalized pencils \[ B_\theta-\lambda G, \] we develop a learning-oriented methodology for spectral certification, sensitivity analysis, and control without requiring symmetry, nonnegativity, or cone preservation. In the positive-orthant setting, computable lower and upper cone bounds provide an a posteriori enclosure of a distinguished cone level, while smooth soft-min/max surrogates preserve rigorous one-sided bounds with explicit approximation errors and remain differentiable with respect to the trainable parameters. translated_title: 锥扩展瑞利商用于有向图学习：极小极大谱证书、敏感性与自适应控制
translated_abstract: 有向图学习自然导致可训练的非对称传播算子，其具有不同的右谱和左谱结构。基于广义束 \[ B_\theta-\lambda G \] 的双侧锥瑞利框架，我们开发了一种面向学习的谱认证、敏感性分析和控制方法，无需对称性、非负性或锥保持性要求。在正象限设置中，可计算的下锥界和上锥界提供了对特定锥水平的后验包络，而平滑的软最小/最大替代函数保持了严格单侧界，并具有显式近似误差，且相对于可训练参数可微。对于简单内部水平，右模和左模满足 \[ D\lambda_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C \]，从而在指定扰动预算下产生一阶最优图支持干预，并激发自适应谱控制。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需对称性或非负性约束的有向图学习谱认证与控制方法，利用锥扩展瑞利商实现可微的严格边界和最优干预。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spectral certification and control method for directed graph learning without symmetry or nonnegativity constraints, leveraging cone extended Rayleigh quotients for differentiable rigorous bounds and optimal interventions.
